newsitem.title: ROMANIA: BUCHAREST BOURSE PRICES MIXED, TURNOVER DOWN.
newsitem.headline: BUCHAREST BOURSE PRICES MIXED, TURNOVER DOWN.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse slipped on Tuesday amid low interest in the slack summer period, one broker said. Overall turnover fell to 6.32 billion lei from 7.82 billion previous.
Average prices for 25 stocks fell and 23 rose. Three stocks had no trade and one remained suspended.
Operators expected no major changes for Monday when they said the market would slip further amid thin interest.
Three independent market indices, the VAB, the BIG and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, edged down by 0.6, 1.01 and 0.71 percent respectively.
"Investors focused on Terapia, which saw increased demand, but overall trading was subdued," one broker said.
First-tier pharmaceutical plant Terapia closed 300 lei firmer at 10,100.
Refrigerator maker Arctic, which has attracted the most recent attention on the first tier, inched down 100 lei to 3,500 under selling pressure.
On the second tier, trade remained idle.
